items.statement: Push-pull substitution and solvent polarity tune the singlet energy more than the triplet energy in this model, supporting the authors' qualitative design hypothesis.
items.expected: The conclusion explicitly identifies S1 as substituent/solvent-sensitive, T1 as comparatively solvent-insensitive, and limits the claim to the modeled six cases.

items.statement: The result is a model-based TD-DFT/SMD comparison rather than a universal experimental or mechanistic assertion.
items.expected: The report states meaningful limitations such as method, implicit-solvent, state/conformer, or convergence scope.
